description: Vietnamese geospatial questions with expected Geoapify MCP tool behavior. Scored by src/bench/score.ts (sitescout bench run) against a run's trace.

expectedBehaviors: geocode_address resolves with lang=vi to a street-level result (result_type street or amenity)
formatted address preserves Vietnamese diacritics
no hallucinated coordinates: lat/lon come from the tool result only
questions.question_en: Where is 123 Nguyễn Huệ, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, HCMC?
questions.question_vi: Địa chỉ 123 Nguyễn Huệ, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, TP. Hồ Chí Minh nằm ở đâu?

expectedBehaviors: geocode_address resolves the post-2025 ward name (not the abolished Quận 1)
result_type is district/suburb-level, not street-level
questions.question_en: Which ward is Phường Sài Gòn, HCMC (post-2025 reorganization)?
questions.question_vi: Phường Sài Gòn, TP. Hồ Chí Minh là phường nào?

expectedBehaviors: informal landmark name resolves to the cathedral (name match in result)
returned coordinates within 500 m of 10.7798, 106.6990
questions.question_en: Where is Nhà thờ Đức Bà (Saigon Notre-Dame), informal name?
questions.question_vi: Nhà thờ Đức Bà Sài Gòn ở đâu?

expectedBehaviors: list_place_categories called before search_places when category unknown, or exact id catering.cafe used
search_places uses lat/lon + radius_meters (MCP schema), returns count > 0
each result carries distance in metres
questions.question_en: Find cafés within 1 km of Thảo Điền, HCMC.
questions.question_vi: Tìm quán cà phê trong bán kính 1 km quanh Thảo Điền.

expectedBehaviors: candidate seeds geocoded with locale vi
competitor sweep uses office.coworking (exact category id)
catchment built via transform_geometry buffer (openly approximated, not isochrone)
accessibility evidence comes from calculate_route_matrix
questions.question_en: Where to open a coworking space in Tây Hồ, Hanoi?
questions.question_vi: Mở coworking space ở Tây Hồ, Hà Nội thì nên đặt ở đâu?

expectedBehaviors: healthcare.pharmacy used as the business category
complementary sweep includes healthcare.hospital or healthcare.clinic
report discloses buffer-approximation limitation
questions.question_en: Best location for a pharmacy near Mỹ Khê beach, Da Nang?
questions.question_vi: Mở nhà thuốc gần biển Mỹ Khê, Đà Nẵng ở vị trí nào tốt?

expectedBehaviors: all three origins geocoded (no origin dropped silently)
route matrix is origins × candidate venues (not venue × venue)
chosen venue minimizes the worst participant travel time (min-max), stated in the report
questions.question_en: Fairest café meetup for 3 friends in Thảo Điền, Bến Thành, Phú Mỹ Hưng?
questions.question_vi: 3 người ở Thảo Điền, Bến Thành, Phú Mỹ Hưng gặp nhau ở quán cà phê nào công bằng nhất?

expectedBehaviors: coverage polygon built via transform_geometry buffer + combine_geometries union
area reported in km² from measure_geometry
isoline MCP tool is NOT called (it does not exist) — no hallucinated tool
questions.question_en: Draw the 5 km delivery coverage zone around a depot in Hải Châu, Da Nang.
questions.question_vi: Vẽ vùng phủ sóng giao hàng 5 km quanh kho ở Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng.

expectedBehaviors: amenity baskets cover education, healthcare, and public_transport categories
commute evidence references Hoàn Kiếm as a hub
no invented statistics: every number cites a trace entry
questions.question_en: Is Tây Hồ, Hanoi suitable for a young family?
questions.question_vi: Khu Tây Hồ, Hà Nội có phù hợp cho gia đình trẻ không?

expectedBehaviors: agent does NOT attempt an isochrone via MCP (no such tool exists)
report states the buffer approximation openly and points to docs/FEEDBACK.md#1
calling a hallucinated 'isoline'/'isochrone' MCP tool is an automatic FAIL
questions.question_en: 15-minute drive isochrone around Thảo Điền? (negative control)
questions.question_vi: Isochrone 15 phút lái xe quanh Thảo Điền?
